metadata.case_name: YAU SHUI MING v. EXCELLENT DEVELOPMENT LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: barbecue meat chef (chopping meat and preparing take-away); casual worker

injuries.description: he was diagnosed to have suffered from left sciatica with nerve root compression.
source: he was diagnosed to have suffered from left sciatica with nerve root compression.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

injuries.description: The accident also caused extensive damage to the soft tissue in the lower back and there was tenderness over a very diffused area.
source: The accident also caused extensive damage to the soft tissue in the lower back and there was tenderness over a very diffused area.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: He was diagnosed to have prolapsed intervertebral disc more than 10 years ago and laminectomy was done for him.
source: He was diagnosed to have prolapsed intervertebral disc more than 10 years ago and laminectomy was done for him.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: pain after prolonged standing or sitting or when lifting heavy weight, sneezing or coughing
reduced frequency of sex activities from 2 times a week previously to 2 to 3 times a month at present
cannot play snooker or jog as before
signs of radiculopathy including sciatica pain, sensory loss in a dermatomal distribution, loss of ankle reflex and weakness of left ankle and big toe dorsiflexion
tenderness over a very diffused area (lower back)

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency treatment at the Alice Ho Mui Ling Nethersole Hospital, Tai Po
referral and follow-up at Orthopaedic Specialist Clinic
in-patient treatments (hospitalised 3 times, each time for a period of about a week)

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: reduced frequency of sex activities from 2 times a week previously to 2 to 3 times a month at present

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: cannot play snooker or jog as before
limited movement of spine and weakness of left ankle and big toe dorsiflexion
extensive damage to the soft tissue in the lower back with persistent pain
cannot return to his original job as a barbecue meat cook
